question: public_list
detail: The European database publishes data centre figures only in aggregated form, by member state and EU-wide, not facility by facility. A rating scheme adopted in September 2026 would put each data centre's name, operator and location on a label, once it is in force.

question: energy_reporting
detail: Operators of data centres with an installed IT power demand of at least 500 kW must report energy and water indicators every year to the European database.
source_title: Commission: energy performance of data centres

question: official_figures
detail: The Commission publishes an online dashboard of the aggregated data, and reports analysing it (July 2025, and September 2026). Figures are aggregated, not per data centre.
source_title: Commission: energy performance of data centres

question: public_list
detail: Germany published its data-centre register on 14 August 2026, but the Federal Environment Agency says the coverage of published data centres is highly incomplete.

question: energy_reporting
detail: Under the Energy Efficiency Act (EnEfG), data centre operators report each year to the national register, which passes the data to the European database.
source_title: Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs: data-centre register

question: official_figures
detail: The Central Statistics Office publishes data centres' metered electricity use: 7,663 GWh in 2025, 23% of all metered electricity, from meter data.
source_title: CSO: Data Centres Metered Electricity Consumption 2025
